```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(knitr)
})

# 项目根：从当前目录逐级上溯找 assets/ 标记（与运行位置无关）
find_root <- function() {
  cur <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(cur, "assets"))) return(cur)
    up <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(up, cur)) stop("未找到含 assets/ 的项目根目录")
    cur <- up
  }
}
root <- find_root()
source(file.path(root, "assets", "tt_theme.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")

# ---- 本周色彩（只在本周生效；共享 theme 不含任何色值）----
# 五个色值，语义固定，跨图不换位：
#   bg   —— 中灰纸面，同时充当面板内的网格色（不引第六个值）
#   card —— 白卡面，panel 底色
#   ink  —— 深蓝黑，标题 / 数据点 / 轴文字 / 栏线
#   body —— 铁灰蓝，副标题 / 脚注 / 轴标题
#   gold —— 金，唯一强调色：AIOE 零线、被点名的专业、组内引导线、图内读数
PAL <- list(
  bg   = "#ECEDEE",
  card = "#FFFFFF",
  ink  = "#14213D",
  body = "#5C6479",
  gold = "#8C6B21"
)

# ---- 本周字体决策：两族，按角色分工（标题族 + 数据族）----
# 报纸的编辑声部用衬线（Georgia），数据声部用无衬线（Segoe UI）。
# 家族数 2 = TT_FAMILY_MAX。首屏 KPI 数字走页面自身字体栈，不参与图内决策。
FAM_T <- "Georgia"
FAM_D <- TT_FAMILY[["text"]]
mm <- function(pt) pt / .pt          # element_text 用 pt，geom_text 用 mm

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png", dpi = TT_EXPORT$dpi,
                      dev.args = list(bg = PAL$bg))

# 本周主题：一处收口，四张图共用（栏线、衬线标题、无网格、无图例）
news <- function() {
  tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$ink, body = PAL$body, grid = PAL$bg, family = FAM_D) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = PAL$card, colour = NA),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(colour = PAL$ink, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.32),
      plot.title       = element_text(family = FAM_T, face = "bold", colour = PAL$ink,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["title"]], hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 3)),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$body,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 11), lineheight = 1.22),
      plot.caption     = element_text(family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$body,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(t = 11), lineheight = 1.4),
      axis.text        = element_text(family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$ink,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
      axis.title       = element_text(family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$body,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]]),
      strip.text       = element_text(family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$ink, face = "bold",
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]], hjust = 0),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.margin      = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
    )
}

# 散点类共用的坐标上下限，凡用到的图都取同一组，面板之间可横向对比
XLIM <- c(9000, 130000)
YLIM <- c(-1.45, 1.62)
XBRK <- c(15000, 25000, 40000, 60000, 100000)
XLAB <- c("$15k", "$25k", "$40k", "$60k", "$100k")

raw  <- read_csv("../data/ai_salary_majors.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
occs <- read_csv("../data/major_occupations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: metrics
#| echo: false
# 全页共用的标量：先算一次，正文与四张图都引用同一份
n_majors <- nrow(raw)
stopifnot(n_distinct(raw$cip4) == n_majors)              # 一行一个专业

cor_ci <- function(x, y) {
  r  <- cor(x, y)
  z  <- atanh(r)
  se <- 1 / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)) - 3)
  c(r = r, lo = tanh(z - 1.96 * se), hi = tanh(z + 1.96 * se))
}
ci_all  <- cor_ci(raw$median_starting_salary, raw$ai_exposure)
ci_lang <- cor_ci(raw$median_starting_salary, raw$ai_exposure_language)
ci_img  <- cor_ci(raw$median_starting_salary, raw$ai_exposure_image)
r_all  <- ci_all[["r"]]
r_lang <- ci_lang[["r"]]
r_img  <- ci_img[["r"]]
r_lang_tot <- cor(raw$ai_exposure, raw$ai_exposure_language)
r_img_tot  <- cor(raw$ai_exposure, raw$ai_exposure_image)
r_lang_img <- cor(raw$ai_exposure_language, raw$ai_exposure_image)
rho_all <- cor(raw$median_starting_salary, raw$ai_exposure, method = "spearman")
r_log   <- cor(log10(raw$median_starting_salary), raw$ai_exposure)

med_pay  <- median(raw$median_starting_salary)
med_exp  <- median(raw$ai_exposure)
n_below0 <- sum(raw$ai_exposure < 0)
pct_below0 <- 100 * n_below0 / n_majors
stopifnot(abs(mean(raw$ai_exposure)) > 0.5)   # 专业层面并不以 0 为中心
```

# 一个被拆开后消失的零

<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;margin:20px 0 6px;border-top:2px solid #14213D;border-bottom:1px solid #14213D">
<div style="flex:1 1 30%;min-width:200px;padding:12px 18px 10px 0;border-right:1px solid #ECEDEE">
<div style="font-size:27px;font-weight:700;color:#14213D;line-height:1.05">≈ 0</div>
<div style="font-size:12px;color:#5C6479;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5">285 个专业的起薪 × 总 AI 暴露度<br>Pearson r = 0.0045（95% CI −0.11 ~ 0.12）</div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1 1 30%;min-width:200px;padding:12px 18px 10px;border-right:1px solid #ECEDEE">
<div style="font-size:27px;font-weight:700;color:#8C6B21;line-height:1.05">−0.16</div>
<div style="font-size:12px;color:#5C6479;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5">语言任务暴露 × 起薪<br>95% CI 不含 0（−0.27 ~ −0.04）</div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1 1 30%;min-width:200px;padding:12px 0 10px 18px">
<div style="font-size:27px;font-weight:700;color:#8C6B21;line-height:1.05">+0.33</div>
<div style="font-size:12px;color:#5C6479;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5">图像任务暴露 × 起薪<br>95% CI 不含 0（+0.22 ~ +0.43）</div>
</div>
</div>

官方说明写这两个变量「几乎不相关（r 约为 0.01）」。我自己复算是 `r sprintf("%.4f", r_all)`，那句话没错：这个零不是「没有关系」，是两股方向相反的关系抵消出来的。

把 AIOE 拆成语言任务与图像任务两支，一支向下（`r sprintf("%.3f", r_lang)`）、一支向上（`r sprintf("%.3f", r_img)`），两个置信区间都不含 0。

所以本周的主线不是「AI 暴露与薪资无关」，而是**「AI 暴露」这个大词把两件事压在了一起**，而这两件事在薪资上指向相反的方向。再往下一层，那个正号也大半来自「工科整体又高又贵」的组间差别，而不是同专业内部的关系。

## 一、先讲口径：285 个专业是怎么来的

```{r}
#| label: scope
#| echo: false
n_occ_pairs <- nrow(occs)
n_soc <- n_distinct(occs$soc)
stopifnot(n_distinct(occs$cip4) == n_majors)              # 职业表覆盖同一批专业
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(occs[, c("cip4", "soc")])))

n_inst        <- raw$n_institutions
n_single_inst <- sum(n_inst == 1)
n_le10_inst   <- sum(n_inst <= 10)
med_inst      <- median(n_inst)

src_tbl <- tribble(
  ~来源, ~在本页用到的列, ~口径,
  "College Scorecard（美国教育部，field-of-study 文件）", "median_starting_salary", "学士学位毕业一年后的收入中位数；院校级值再按 4 位 CIP 取中位数，不按毕业生人数加权",
  "AIOE（Felten, Raj & Seamans 2021）", "ai_exposure, ai_exposure_language, ai_exposure_image", "职业（SOC）层面的标准化分数，均值 0、标准差 1；一个专业取其全部去向职业的算术平均",
  "NCES/BLS CIP2020 → SOC2018 crosswalk", "cip4, soc（在 major_occupations.csv 里）", "把专业连到毕业生的常见职业；一个专业连 1 ~ 36 个职业"
)
```

`r n_majors` 个专业不是「所有专业」，而是**「起薪与 AIOE 两头都有值」的交集**：Scorecard 里有毕业一年后收入的 4 位 CIP，乘上 crosswalk 能连到至少一个带 AIOE 分数的职业，剩下的就是这 `r n_majors` 个。

底层是 `r format(n_occ_pairs, big.mark = ",")` 条专业 × 职业连线，覆盖 `r n_soc` 个不同职业——下面所有暴露度数字都从这张表算出来。

四个必须先交代的口径：

1. **起薪不是「应届起薪」**，是毕业**一年后**的收入中位数；而且是院校级中位数的中位数。只有 `r n_single_inst` 个专业只来自 1 所院校、`r n_le10_inst` 个不超过 10 所（中位 `r med_inst` 所），所以起薪的差距里混着「哪些院校开设这个专业」。
2. **AIOE 的 0 是「平均职业」，不是「平均专业」**。专业层面只有 `r n_below0` 个（`r sprintf("%.1f", pct_below0)`%）落在 0 以下，专业中位数是 `r sprintf("%.3f", med_exp)`——crosswalk 连的都是专业技术岗，本来就比全职业平均更暴露。**所以原分数的正负不要当「安全 / 危险」的分界，要读 `ai_exposure_percentile`。**
3. **暴露度 ≠ 会被取代**。AIOE 量的是「这个职业需要的能力与 AI 能做的事重叠多少」，重叠可以是替代也可以是辅助；它不含岗位数量、工资弹性或时间表。
4. **`ai_exposure` 几乎就是语言那一支**：它与 `ai_exposure_language` 的相关是 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_lang_tot)`，与 `ai_exposure_image` 只有 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_img_tot)`。这正是第三节要拆的理由。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-source
#| echo: false
src_tbl |> kable(format = "html",
  caption = "三个数据来源与各自的口径（本周只用这两份 CSV 的 13 + 7 列，不回溯原始 xlsx）")
```

## 二、总暴露度与起薪：一条真正平的线

```{r}
#| label: prep-quadrant
#| echo: false
# 四象限：竖分割在中位起薪，横分割在 AIOE 的原点 0（两者基准不同，见脚注）
quad <- raw |>
  mutate(q = case_when(
    median_starting_salary >= med_pay & ai_exposure >= 0 ~ "HI pay · above-avg exposure",
    median_starting_salary >= med_pay & ai_exposure <  0 ~ "HI pay · below-avg exposure",
    median_starting_salary <  med_pay & ai_exposure >= 0 ~ "LO pay · above-avg exposure",
    TRUE                                                 ~ "LO pay · below-avg exposure"
  ))
qt <- quad |>
  summarise(n = n(), mp = median(median_starting_salary), me = median(ai_exposure),
            .by = q) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
stopifnot(sum(qt$n) == n_majors, nrow(qt) == 4)

# 换成「专业中位暴露度」做横线的另一种切法，用来证明象限数是切法敏感的
alt_hh <- sum(raw$median_starting_salary >= med_pay & raw$ai_exposure >= med_exp)
alt_hl <- sum(raw$median_starting_salary >= med_pay & raw$ai_exposure <  med_exp)
alt_lh <- sum(raw$median_starting_salary <  med_pay & raw$ai_exposure >= med_exp)
alt_ll <- sum(raw$median_starting_salary <  med_pay & raw$ai_exposure <  med_exp)
stopifnot(alt_hh + alt_hl + alt_lh + alt_ll == n_majors)
alt_qt <- tibble::tribble(
  ~q_alt,                            ~n,
  "HI pay · above median exposure",  alt_hh,
  "HI pay · below median exposure",  alt_hl,
  "LO pay · above median exposure",  alt_lh,
  "LO pay · below median exposure",  alt_ll
) |>
  mutate(share = 100 * n / n_majors) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

# 图 1 点名的 9 个专业：两端各取几个 + 官方点到的两个
lab_cip <- c("1514", "5138", "1107", "2705", "3801", "3020", "5005", "5003", "5139")
lab_short <- c(
  "1514" = "Nuclear eng. tech.\n(1 institution)",
  "5138" = "Registered nursing",
  "1107" = "Computer science",
  "2705" = "Statistics",
  "3801" = "Philosophy",
  "3020" = "International studies",
  "5005" = "Drama & theatre",
  "5003" = "Dance",
  "5139" = "Practical nursing"
)
lab_df <- raw |> filter(cip4 %in% lab_cip) |> mutate(lab = unname(lab_short[cip4]))
stopifnot(nrow(lab_df) == length(lab_cip))

# 四象限的角标读数（位置取面板四角，均落在空白处）
qtag <- tribble(
  ~x,      ~y,     ~hj, ~vj, ~q,
  10300,    1.56,  0,   1,   "LO pay · above-avg exposure",
  119000,   1.56,  1,   1,   "HI pay · above-avg exposure",
  10300,   -1.40,  0,   0,   "LO pay · below-avg exposure",
  119000,  -1.40,  1,   0,   "HI pay · below-avg exposure"
) |>
  left_join(qt, by = "q") |>
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s\nn = %d", q, n))
stopifnot(!anyNA(qtag$n))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-quadrant
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Starting pay and overall AI exposure are unrelated across 285 majors; the gold points are the nine majors named in the text and the quadrant counts are printed in each corner."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.0
fig1 <- ggplot(raw, aes(x = median_starting_salary, y = ai_exposure)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$gold, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_pay, colour = PAL$ink, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$ink, size = 1.35, alpha = 0.55, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = lab_df, colour = PAL$gold, size = 2.5, stroke = 0) +
  geom_label_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = lab), family = FAM_D,
                   colour = PAL$ink, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
                   fill = PAL$card, label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(1.5, "pt"),
                   lineheight = 0.95, box.padding = 0.42, point.padding = 0.22,
                   min.segment.length = 0, segment.colour = PAL$body,
                   segment.size = 0.22, max.overlaps = 40, seed = 20261020) +
  geom_text(data = qtag, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab, hjust = hj, vjust = vj),
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$body, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
            lineheight = 1.25) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = XLIM, breaks = XBRK, labels = XLAB,
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = YLIM, breaks = seq(-1, 1.5, 0.5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Pay and AI exposure simply do not move together",
    subtitle = paste0("Median earnings one year after graduation against the average AIOE of each ",
                      "major's occupations"),
    x = "median earnings one year after graduation (log scale)",
    y = "average AIOE exposure of the major's occupations",
    caption  = tt_source("ai_salary_majors.csv", n_majors,
      sprintf(paste0("Pearson r = %.4f (95%% CI %.3f to %.3f), Spearman %.3f, and %.3f on the log ",
                     "of pay, so the flatness is not a scale artefact. The gold rule is AIOE = 0, ",
                     "the average occupation; only %d of %d majors sit below it. The dashed rule is ",
                     "the median major's pay ($%s), so the two dividers use different baselines: the ",
                     "exposure axis is split at the index origin, the pay axis at the median. AIOE ",
                     "measures overlap with what AI can do, not the probability of replacement."),
              r_all, ci_all[["lo"]], ci_all[["hi"]], rho_all, r_log,
              n_below0, n_majors, format(med_pay, big.mark = ",")))
  ) +
  news()
fig1
```

**读数**：整条相关是 `r sprintf("%.4f", r_all)`，95% 置信区间 `r sprintf("%.3f", ci_all[["lo"]])` ~ `r sprintf("%.3f", ci_all[["hi"]])`——宽得足以装下「中等负相关」到「中等正相关」，也就是说**这份数据排除不了任何温和的关系，只能排除强关系**。换成 Spearman（`r sprintf("%.3f", rho_all)`）、换成 log 起薪（`r sprintf("%.3f", r_log)`）都还是零，这个零不是尺度造成的。

四象限几乎均分：人最多的一格 `r max(qt$n)` 个（低薪 × 高暴露），最少的一格 `r min(qt$n)` 个（低薪 × 低暴露），四个角上已印着各自的数量。

**横竖两条线的基准不一样**：竖线是中位起薪 $`r format(med_pay, big.mark = ",")`，横线却是 AIOE 的原点 0，也就是「平均职业」，不是专业的中位数。这不是疏漏，是两把尺子各自的原点。

把横线挪到专业中位暴露度 `r sprintf("%.3f", med_exp)` 再切一次，四象限仍然均分（见下表）。两种切法都不给结论，这正是「无关系」的样子。

图里还有两处该记住的。左上角孤零零的 `Nuclear eng. tech.` 暴露度百分位只有 `r sprintf("%.1f", lab_df$ai_exposure_percentile[lab_df$cip4 == "1514"])`，起薪却是 $`r format(lab_df$median_starting_salary[lab_df$cip4 == "1514"], big.mark = ",")`。

右下角的 `Registered nursing` 百分位 `r sprintf("%.1f", lab_df$ai_exposure_percentile[lab_df$cip4 == "5138"])`、起薪 $`r format(lab_df$median_starting_salary[lab_df$cip4 == "5138"], big.mark = ",")`，与它落在同一档。

但前者**只来自 `r raw$n_institutions[raw$cip4 == "1514"]` 所院校**，后者背后有 `r format(raw$n_institutions[raw$cip4 == "5138"], big.mark = ",")` 所院校、`r format(raw$n_graduates[raw$cip4 == "5138"], big.mark = ",")` 个毕业生。**同一档「低暴露、高薪」，证据强度完全不同**，读图时不该同等对待。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-quadrant
#| echo: false
qt |>
  transmute(`象限（竖线 = 中位起薪，横线 = AIOE 0）` = q, `专业数` = n,
            `占比` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n / n_majors),
            `象限内中位起薪` = format(mp, big.mark = ","),
            `象限内中位暴露度` = sprintf("%.3f", me)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "四象限的原始数字，对应图 1（同一份 285 行的聚合；象限边界混用两种基准，见正文）")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-quadrant-alt
#| echo: false
alt_qt |>
  transmute(`象限（竖线 = 中位起薪，横线 = 专业中位暴露度）` = q_alt, `专业数` = n,
            `占比` = sprintf("%.1f%%", share)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = sprintf(paste0("换一种切法：横线从 AIOE 0 挪到专业中位暴露度 %.3f，",
                                 "四象限仍然均分（与上表同一批 285 个专业）"), med_exp))
```

## 三、拆开「AI 暴露」，两条反向的线

```{r}
#| label: prep-tercile
#| echo: false
# 每个任务维度各自三等分：只保留上三分之一与下三分之一，中间三分之一不入图。
# 用秩均分（ntile）而不是 quantile 阈值：分位点上存在并列（语言维度第 2/3 分位上有
# tie_lang 个专业同分，图像维度 tie_img 个），按阈值切会切出 97/95/93 这种不等量，
# 也会让两个面板的对比基准不一致。并列按行序归入，计数写进图 2 脚注。
tier_of <- function(x) {
  k <- ntile(x, 3)
  ifelse(k == 1L, "bottom third", ifelse(k == 3L, "top third", NA_character_))
}
tk <- raw |>
  transmute(cip4, pay = median_starting_salary,
            lang_tier = tier_of(ai_exposure_language),
            img_tier  = tier_of(ai_exposure_image))
n_tier <- sum(!is.na(tk$lang_tier))
stopifnot(n_tier == sum(!is.na(tk$img_tier)), n_tier == 190)
cut_lang <- quantile(raw$ai_exposure_language, 2 / 3)
cut_img  <- quantile(raw$ai_exposure_image,  2 / 3)
tie_lang <- sum(raw$ai_exposure_language == cut_lang)
tie_img  <- sum(raw$ai_exposure_image == cut_img)

band <- bind_rows(
  tk |> filter(!is.na(lang_tier)) |>
    transmute(task = "Language-task exposure", tier = lang_tier, pay),
  tk |> filter(!is.na(img_tier)) |>
    transmute(task = "Image-generation exposure", tier = img_tier, pay)
) |>
  mutate(task = factor(task, levels = c("Language-task exposure", "Image-generation exposure")),
         tier = factor(tier, levels = c("bottom third", "top third")))

# 密度在 log10(起薪) 上算，再变换回美元坐标——直接对美元算密度会把形状拉歪
dens <- band |>
  group_by(task, tier) |>
  reframe({
    de <- density(log10(pay), adjust = 0.85, n = 512)
    tibble(pay = 10^de$x, d = de$y)
  }) |>
  ungroup()

terc <- band |>
  summarise(n = n(), p25 = quantile(pay, .25), p50 = median(pay),
            p75 = quantile(pay, .75), mean_log = mean(log10(pay)),
            .by = c(task, tier)) |>
  arrange(task, tier)
stopifnot(nrow(terc) == 4, all(terc$n == 95))

pick_med <- function(t, tt) terc$p50[terc$task == t & terc$tier == tt]
pick_gm  <- function(t, tt) terc$mean_log[terc$task == t & terc$tier == tt]
lang_lo <- pick_med("Language-task exposure", "bottom third")
lang_hi <- pick_med("Language-task exposure", "top third")
img_lo  <- pick_med("Image-generation exposure", "bottom third")
img_hi  <- pick_med("Image-generation exposure", "top third")
lang_gap <- lang_hi - lang_lo
img_gap  <- img_hi - img_lo
img_ratio <- img_hi / img_lo
lang_log_ratio <- 10^(pick_gm("Language-task exposure", "top third") -
                      pick_gm("Language-task exposure", "bottom third"))
img_log_ratio  <- 10^(pick_gm("Image-generation exposure", "top third") -
                      pick_gm("Image-generation exposure", "bottom third"))

# 图内读数块：钉在每个面板右上角（那里密度已归零），不占曲线
ymax_d <- dens |> summarise(ymax = max(d) * 1.06, .by = task)
readout <- terc |>
  summarise(top = p50[tier == "top third"], bot = p50[tier == "bottom third"],
            .by = task) |>
  left_join(ymax_d, by = "task") |>
  mutate(gap = top - bot,
         gap_txt = if_else(gap < 0,
                           sprintf("gap  \u2212$%.1fk", abs(gap) / 1000),
                           sprintf("gap  +$%.1fk", gap / 1000))) |>
  reframe(x = 11200,
          y = ymax * c(0.99, 0.90, 0.81),
          lab = c(sprintf("top third   $%.1fk", top / 1000),
                  sprintf("bottom third   $%.1fk", bot / 1000),
                  gap_txt),
          .by = task)

# 表 3 末列：同一维度内上三分位相对下三分位的几何均值倍数
terc <- terc |>
  mutate(geom_ratio = if_else(tier != "top third", NA_character_,
           if_else(task == "Language-task exposure",
                   sprintf("%.3f", lang_log_ratio),
                   sprintf("%.3f", img_log_ratio))))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-tercile
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Language-task exposure and image-generation exposure pull starting pay in opposite directions: the top third by language exposure earns less than the bottom third, while the top third by image exposure earns about 1.7 times as much."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 5.0
med_marks <- terc |>
  left_join(ymax_d, by = "task") |>
  mutate(col = if_else(tier == "top third", PAL$gold, PAL$ink))

fig2 <- ggplot(dens, aes(x = pay, y = d)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = tier), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = med_marks,
               aes(x = p50, xend = p50, y = 0, yend = ymax * 0.86, colour = tier),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.32, linetype = "22") +
  geom_text(data = readout, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$ink, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, lineheight = 1.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ task, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("bottom third" = PAL$ink, "top third" = PAL$gold)) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = XLIM, breaks = XBRK, labels = XLAB,
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Split the index in two and it stops being a flat line",
    subtitle = paste0("Distribution of starting pay in the bottom versus the top third of each task ",
                      "dimension\n", "(middle third withheld); the dashed rule is that third's median"),
    x = "median earnings one year after graduation (log scale)",
    y = "density per log10 dollar unit",
    caption  = tt_source("ai_salary_majors.csv", NULL,
      sprintf(paste0("n = 190 majors per panel (95 per curve; the middle third of each dimension is ",
                     "withheld, so the two panels are the same 285 majors cut two different ways). ",
                     "Thirds are cut by rank, so boundary ties (%d majors share the language cut, ",
                     "%d the image cut) fall to the side their row order puts them. ",
                     "Language: top-third median $%.1fk against bottom-third $%.1fk, which is %.1f%% ",
                     "lower in level and %.3f in geometric mean. Image: $%.1fk against $%.1fk, or ",
                     "x%.2f and %.3f in geometric mean. Pearson r on pay is %.3f for language ",
                     "(95%% CI %.3f to %.3f) and %.3f for image (%.3f to %.3f): one interval sits ",
                     "entirely below zero, the other entirely above."),
              tie_lang, tie_img,
              lang_hi / 1000, lang_lo / 1000, 100 * lang_gap / lang_lo, lang_log_ratio,
              img_hi / 1000, img_lo / 1000, img_ratio, img_log_ratio,
              r_lang, ci_lang[["lo"]], ci_lang[["hi"]],
              r_img, ci_img[["lo"]], ci_img[["hi"]]))
  ) +
  news() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(20, "pt"))
fig2
```

```{r}
#| label: flow-tercile
#| echo: false
flow_terc <- tt_flow(n_majors, 190, "两个维度各弃掉中间三分之一，各 95 个专业")
```

> `r flow_terc`

**读数**：语言暴露这一支是反的。上三分位的中位起薪 $`r sprintf("%.1f", lang_hi / 1000)`k，比下三分位的 $`r sprintf("%.1f", lang_lo / 1000)`k 少 `r format(abs(round(lang_gap)), big.mark = ",")`。**暴露更高的人反而赚得少。**

图像暴露则相反：$`r sprintf("%.1f", img_hi / 1000)`k 对 $`r sprintf("%.1f", img_lo / 1000)`k，`r sprintf("%.2f", img_ratio)` 倍。换成几何均值口径，方向一致（`r sprintf("%.3f", lang_log_ratio)` 与 `r sprintf("%.3f", img_log_ratio)`）。

**两个维度不是同一个东西的两个刻度，而是两个方向相反的信号**——这就是把它们平均成一个 `ai_exposure` 之后相关归零的直接原因。

但这张图**不能**用来证明「图像任务暴露越高越挣得多」。它只把 285 个专业整体切三份，切出来的差别里有很大一块是组间差别：图像暴露高的专业集中在工科与建筑，而这些专业本来就薪高。下一节用组内相关直接检验。语言那一支虽不含 0，效应量只有 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_lang)`，属于「稳定但微弱」，不要读成「读语言类专业就完了」。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tercile
#| echo: false
terc |>
  transmute(`任务维度` = as.character(task), `三分位` = as.character(tier), n,
            `P25` = format(round(p25), big.mark = ","),
            `中位数` = format(round(p50), big.mark = ","),
            `P75` = format(round(p75), big.mark = ","),
            `几何均值倍数（上÷下）` = if_else(is.na(geom_ratio), "", geom_ratio)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "两个任务维度的分位数字，对应图 2（美元；末列只有上三分位那一行有值，是相对同维度下三分位的几何均值倍数）")
```

## 四、那个「0」是四个组互相抵消出来的

```{r}
#| label: prep-group
#| echo: false
# 分组：把 37 个 broad_field_short 收成 4 组（分面吃不下 37 级）。
# 分组只为读图，不是官方分类，规则即下面这张表，明细见「方法与口径」。
grp_of <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c("Engineering", "Engineering Tech", "Computer Science",
             "Physical Sciences", "Mathematics & Statistics", "Science Tech") ~
      "Engineering & science",
    x %in% c("Health Professions", "Biological Sciences", "Agriculture",
             "Natural Resources") ~ "Health & life sciences",
    x %in% c("English", "Philosophy & Religion", "Visual & Performing Arts",
             "Foreign Languages", "History", "Area & Ethnic Studies",
             "Theology & Religion", "Liberal Arts", "Library Science",
             "Communication", "Communications Tech", "Psychology", "Social Sciences") ~
      "Humanities & social sciences",
    TRUE ~ "Business, education & services"
  )
}
grp_lv <- c("Engineering & science", "Health & life sciences",
            "Humanities & social sciences", "Business, education & services")

d <- raw |> mutate(grp = factor(grp_of(broad_field_short), levels = grp_lv))
stopifnot(!anyNA(d$grp), sum(table(d$grp)) == n_majors)

gt <- d |>
  summarise(n = n(), med_pay = median(median_starting_salary),
            med_exp = median(ai_exposure),
            r_all  = cor(median_starting_salary, ai_exposure),
            r_lang = cor(median_starting_salary, ai_exposure_language),
            r_img  = cor(median_starting_salary, ai_exposure_image),
            .by = grp) |>
  arrange(grp)
stopifnot(nrow(gt) == 4)
r_within_all  <- weighted.mean(gt$r_all,  gt$n)
r_within_lang <- weighted.mean(gt$r_lang, gt$n)
r_within_img  <- weighted.mean(gt$r_img,  gt$n)
pay_fold <- gt$med_pay[gt$grp == "Engineering & science"] /
            gt$med_pay[gt$grp == "Humanities & social sciences"]

gtag <- gt |>
  mutate(x = 10300, y = 1.56,
         lab = sprintf("n = %d   r = %s%.2f", n, if_else(r_all >= 0, "+", "\u2212"), abs(r_all)))

# 分组明细：把 4 组各自包含哪些 CIP 大类摊开，读者可自行复核合并规则
grp_members <- d |>
  summarise(`所含 CIP 大类（broad_field_short）` = paste(sort(unique(broad_field_short)),
                                                     collapse = " · "),
            `专业数` = n(), .by = grp) |>
  arrange(grp)
stopifnot(sum(grp_members$`专业数`) == n_majors)

# 引用方便：按组名取值的短函数
gv <- function(col, g) gt[[col]][gt$grp == g]
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-group
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The same 285 majors split by broad field: engineering and science sit high on pay, humanities sit low, yet inside each group exposure and pay barely move the same way - the flat overall line is an average of four groups."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.2
fig3 <- ggplot(d, aes(x = median_starting_salary, y = ai_exposure)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$gold, linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_vline(data = gt, aes(xintercept = med_pay), colour = PAL$ink,
             linewidth = 0.28, linetype = "22", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(colour = PAL$ink, size = 1.05, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
              colour = PAL$gold, linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "22") +
  geom_text(data = gtag, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$ink, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
            fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ grp, nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = XLIM, breaks = XBRK, labels = XLAB,
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = YLIM, breaks = seq(-1, 1.5, 0.5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Four groups, four different places, none of them a slope",
    subtitle = paste0("Same axes as the first figure; the gold rule is AIOE = 0, the dashed gold line ",
                      "is the group's\n", "least-squares fit and the dashed vertical rule is the ",
                      "group's median pay"),
    x = "median earnings one year after graduation (log scale)",
    y = "average AIOE exposure",
    caption  = tt_source("ai_salary_majors.csv", n_majors,
      sprintf(paste0("all four panels share one pair of axes, so panels are comparable. Within-group ",
                     "Pearson r runs from %.2f (business, education and services) to %+.2f (humanities ",
                     "and social sciences); the n-weighted mean of the four is %+.3f, against %.4f ",
                     "pooled. The groups sit at very different median pay ($%s to $%s) with similar ",
                     "median exposure (%.3f to %.3f on the AIOE scale) - that is what flattens the ",
                     "pooled line. Grouping 37 CIP families into four blocks is mine, not NCES."),
              gv("r_all", "Business, education & services"),
              gv("r_all", "Humanities & social sciences"),
              r_within_all, r_all,
              format(round(min(gt$med_pay)), big.mark = ","),
              format(round(max(gt$med_pay)), big.mark = ","),
              min(gt$med_exp), max(gt$med_exp)))
  ) +
  news() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(16, "pt"))
fig3
```

**读数**：四组的中位起薪从 $`r format(gv("med_pay", "Humanities & social sciences"), big.mark = ",")`（人文与社科）到 $`r format(gv("med_pay", "Engineering & science"), big.mark = ",")`（工科与理科）。

**差 `r sprintf("%.2f", pay_fold)` 倍，中位暴露度却几乎并排。** 这就是整体相关被压平的全部机制：暴露度在组间没有系统差异，起薪有巨大的组间差异。

组内相关是另一回事：四个组的符号不一致（末三列见下表），加权后只有 `r sprintf("%+.3f", r_within_all)`。人文社科那一组是明确的正号，因为**这组里暴露度最低的恰是舞蹈、戏剧、纯艺这些起薪两万出头的艺术类专业**——「最不容易被 AI 碰到的人文学科」正好是最穷的那一半。官方那句「部分人文学科又低薪又高暴露」只对另一半成立。

图像那一支的正相关大半也是组间的：四个组的组内 r 都远低于池化的 `r sprintf("%+.3f", r_img)`，加权只剩 `r sprintf("%+.3f", r_within_img)`。**所以第三节那个 +0.33 主要是「工科整体又高又贵」，不是同专业之间的关系。**

```{r}
#| label: tbl-group
#| echo: false
gt |>
  transmute(`组（37 → 4，非官方分类）` = as.character(grp), `专业数` = n,
            `中位起薪` = format(round(med_pay), big.mark = ","),
            `中位暴露度` = sprintf("%.3f", med_exp),
            `r（总暴露）` = sprintf("%+.3f", r_all),
            `r（语言）`   = sprintf("%+.3f", r_lang),
            `r（图像）`   = sprintf("%+.3f", r_img)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "四个组的组内相关与中位数，对应图 3（r 为组内 Pearson，起薪取美元原值；末三列同源同批专业）")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-group-members
#| echo: false
grp_members |>
  transmute(`组` = as.character(grp), `所含 CIP 大类` = `所含 CIP 大类（broad_field_short）`,
            `专业数` = `专业数`) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "分组合并规则明细（左侧 37 个 CIP 大类折成 4 组，是我为读图做的合并，不是 NCES 分类；加起来 = 285）")
```

## 五、专业的暴露度是其职业的平均

```{r}
#| label: prep-fan
#| echo: false
# 六个专业：职业数从 1 到 36，覆盖「一个职业定生死」到「平均掉一整片职业」
sel_cip <- c("5202", "1313", "5005", "5138", "2701", "5139")
sel_short <- c(
  "5202" = "Business administration",
  "1313" = "Teacher education",
  "5005" = "Drama & theatre",
  "5138" = "Registered nursing",
  "2701" = "Mathematics",
  "5139" = "Practical nursing"
)
stopifnot(all(sel_cip %in% raw$cip4))
ord <- order(raw$ai_exposure[match(sel_cip, raw$cip4)])

fan <- occs |>
  filter(cip4 %in% sel_cip) |>
  left_join(raw |> select(cip4, mean_exp = ai_exposure, pay = median_starting_salary),
            by = "cip4") |>
  mutate(major = factor(unname(sel_short[cip4]), levels = unname(sel_short[sel_cip[ord]])))
stopifnot(nrow(fan) == sum(raw$n_occupations[raw$cip4 %in% sel_cip]))

# 确定性纵向抖动：按职业在组内的暴露度排序后交替偏移，不用随机数
fan <- fan |>
  arrange(major, ai_exposure) |>
  mutate(rank_in = row_number(), .by = major) |>
  mutate(off = ((rank_in - 1L) %% 5L - 2L) * 0.062,
         is_end = rank_in == 1L | rank_in == n())

fan_stat <- fan |>
  summarise(n = n(), lo = min(ai_exposure), hi = max(ai_exposure),
            mean_exp = first(mean_exp), pay = first(pay), .by = major) |>
  mutate(rng = hi - lo,
         right = sprintf("n = %d   $%sk", n,
                         format(round(pay / 1000, 1), nsmall = 1)))

# 只给「跨度 > 0.9」的两个专业标出两端职业，避免 88 个点被文字压死
fan_lab <- fan |>
  filter(is_end, major %in% c("Drama & theatre", "Teacher education"))

occ_per_major <- raw$n_occupations
n_shared_soc  <- occs |> count(soc) |> filter(n >= 10) |> nrow()
top_share_soc <- occs |> count(soc, occupation) |> slice_max(n, n = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-fan
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Each major's exposure score is the plain average of the occupations it feeds: drama averages a dancer score of -2.67 with a writer score of +0.99, while practical nursing averages a single occupation and mathematics averages five that all sit near the top."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 4.7
fig4 <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = fan_stat, aes(y = as.numeric(major), yend = as.numeric(major),
                                    x = -3.05, xend = 1.72),
               colour = PAL$bg, linewidth = 2.7, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = PAL$gold, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = fan, aes(x = ai_exposure, y = as.numeric(major) + off),
             colour = PAL$ink, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = fan_stat, aes(x = mean_exp, y = as.numeric(major)),
             colour = PAL$gold, shape = 18, size = 3.2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = fan_lab, aes(x = ai_exposure, y = as.numeric(major) + off,
                                      label = occupation),
                  family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$body, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]),
                  box.padding = 0.34, point.padding = 0.18, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.colour = PAL$body, segment.size = 0.2, nudge_y = 0.17,
                  max.overlaps = 20, seed = 20261021) +
  geom_text(data = fan_stat, aes(x = 1.82, y = as.numeric(major), label = right),
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$ink, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]), hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(fan$major)),
                     labels = levels(fan$major), expand = expansion(add = 0.55)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.1, 2.85), breaks = seq(-2, 1, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title    = "A major's score is its occupations averaged, not the major itself",
    subtitle = paste0("Every occupation behind six majors; the gold diamond is the major-level mean"),
    x = "AIOE exposure of the occupation",
    y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("major_occupations.csv", nrow(fan),
      sprintf(paste0("%d major-occupation links shown out of %s; the light track spans the full ",
                     "range of occupational scores, so a bare stretch is a gap in that major's ",
                     "destinations rather than a missing value. Occupations are stacked within a ",
                     "row in sorted order so overlaps resolve; the mean gives each occupation one ",
                     "vote, exactly as ai_exposure does. %d occupations are each claimed by ten or ",
                     "more majors (the widest, %s, by %d), so generic management and teaching codes ",
                     "pull many majors toward the middle."),
              nrow(fan), format(n_occ_pairs, big.mark = ","), n_shared_soc,
              top_share_soc$occupation, top_share_soc$n))
  ) +
  news()
fig4
```

**读数**：`Drama & theatre` 的 `r fan_stat$n[fan_stat$major == "Drama & theatre"]` 个职业从 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$lo[fan_stat$major == "Drama & theatre"])`（`Dancers`）到 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$hi[fan_stat$major == "Drama & theatre"])`（`Writers and Authors`）。

跨度 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$rng[fan_stat$major == "Drama & theatre"])`，而专业级均值只有 `r sprintf("%.3f", fan_stat$mean_exp[fan_stat$major == "Drama & theatre"])`——**它看起来落在「不暴露」的中段，纯粹是平均的产物**。

`Teacher education` 更宽：`r fan_stat$n[fan_stat$major == "Teacher education"]` 个职业从 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$lo[fan_stat$major == "Teacher education"])`（`Fitness Trainers and Aerobics Instructors`）到 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$hi[fan_stat$major == "Teacher education"])`（历史、英语这类学科教师）。

反方向的极端是 `Mathematics`：`r fan_stat$n[fan_stat$major == "Mathematics"]` 个职业全挤在 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$lo[fan_stat$major == "Mathematics"])` ~ `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$hi[fan_stat$major == "Mathematics"])`。跨度只有 `r sprintf("%.2f", fan_stat$rng[fan_stat$major == "Mathematics"])`，所以它的均值是稳的。`Practical nursing` 只连 `r fan_stat$n[fan_stat$major == "Practical nursing"]` 个职业，分值就是 `Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses` 的原值，没有平均。

**同一列里，有的值是 `r max(occ_per_major)` 个职业的平均，有的就是单职业的原值**——这就是为什么百分位差十分以内不值得当真，也是为什么 `n_occupations` 必须和暴露度一起读。

还有个量表层面的提醒：`r n_shared_soc` 个职业各被 10 个以上专业共用，最多的 `r top_share_soc$occupation` 被 `r top_share_soc$n` 个专业共用。这些通用管理与教师代码把一批专业往中间拉，专业之间的独立信息因此比 285 这个数字听起来少。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fan
#| echo: false
fan_stat |>
  transmute(`专业` = as.character(major), `职业数` = n,
            `最低` = sprintf("%.2f", lo), `最高` = sprintf("%.2f", hi),
            `跨度` = sprintf("%.2f", rng),
            `均值（即 ai_exposure）` = sprintf("%.3f", mean_exp),
            `起薪` = format(round(pay), big.mark = ",")) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "六个专业的职业分布数字，对应图 4（6 个专业、88 条专业×职业连线；跨度为 max − min，均值即 ai_salary_majors 的 ai_exposure）")
```

## 六、这份数据站不住脚的几处

```{r}
#| label: prep-anomaly
#| echo: false
# 全部只记录、不改数据
n_missing_4yr <- sum(is.na(raw$median_salary_4yr))
ratio_4yr <- raw$median_salary_4yr / raw$median_starting_salary
med_ratio_4yr <- median(ratio_4yr, na.rm = TRUE)
max_i <- which.max(ratio_4yr)
max_ratio_4yr <- ratio_4yr[max_i]

name_chk <- raw |>
  select(cip4, a_name = field_of_study) |>
  inner_join(occs |> distinct(cip4, m_name = field_of_study), by = "cip4",
             relationship = "one-to-many")
n_name_diff <- sum(name_chk$a_name != name_chk$m_name)
n_multi_title <- occs |> summarise(k = n_distinct(field_of_study), .by = cip4) |>
  filter(k > 1) |> nrow()

n_pct_ties <- sum(duplicated(raw$ai_exposure_percentile))
max_tie <- raw |> count(ai_exposure_percentile) |> slice_max(n, n = 1)

pay_reg  <- raw$median_starting_salary[raw$cip4 == "5138"]
pay_prac <- raw$median_starting_salary[raw$cip4 == "5139"]
nurse_fold <- pay_reg / pay_prac

top_row <- raw |> slice_max(median_starting_salary, n = 1)
```

| 现象 | 原始数字 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 两个文件对同一 `cip4` 的专业名不是同一套标题 | `r format(n_occ_pairs, big.mark = ",")` 行里 `r n_name_diff` 行不同名；`r n_multi_title` 个专业在职业表里有不止一个 6 位 CIP 标题 | 一律只用 `cip4` 连接，从不按名字 join；图 4 行名用我起的短名 |
| 起薪的机构基础极不均匀 | `r n_single_inst` 个专业只来自 1 所院校，`r n_le10_inst` 个不超过 10 所（中位 `r med_inst` 所） | 不剔除（一刀切会连同顶端一起砍掉），但在图 1 直标里写明其中两个的院校数 |
| 全库最高起薪是个单机构值 | `r top_row$field_of_study` $`r format(top_row$median_starting_salary, big.mark = ",")`，来自 `r top_row$n_institutions` 所院校、`r format(top_row$n_graduates, big.mark = ",")` 个毕业生 | 不改数；它不在图 1 被点名的 9 个里，读「最贵专业」这个名次时必须知道它只代表 1 所院校 |
| 4 年薪资缺失集中在单机构专业 | `r n_missing_4yr` 个专业缺 `median_salary_4yr`，全部是 1 所院校的专业；没有一个专业 4 年低于 1 年 | 本页只用 1 年薪资；4 年列只在这一行做一致性检查 |
| 4 年 ÷ 1 年 的倍数跨度很大 | 中位 `r sprintf("%.2f", med_ratio_4yr)` 倍，最大 `r sprintf("%.2f", max_ratio_4yr)` 倍（`r raw$field_of_study[max_i]`：$`r format(raw$median_starting_salary[max_i], big.mark = ",")` → $`r format(raw$median_salary_4yr[max_i], big.mark = ",")`） | 不拿 4 年列替代 1 年列做稳健性检查，两者不是同一件事 |
| `ai_exposure_percentile` 大量并列 | `r n_pct_ties` 个专业与别的专业同百分位，最多 `r max_tie$n` 个专业同分（`r max_tie$ai_exposure_percentile`） | 百分位只在整数量级上读；图 1 的纵向位置用原分数 |
| AIOE 的 0 不是专业的平均 | 只有 `r n_below0` 个专业（`r sprintf("%.1f", pct_below0)`%）在 0 以下，专业中位 `r sprintf("%.3f", med_exp)` | 象限横线用 AIOE 原点而非专业中位数，图 1 脚注与正文同时说明 |
| 「注册护理约 7.5 万」只对一个 CIP 成立 | `Registered Nursing`（5138）$`r format(pay_reg, big.mark = ",")`；`Practical Nursing`（5139）$`r format(pay_prac, big.mark = ",")`，是**全库最低起薪**，两者差 `r sprintf("%.1f", nurse_fold)` 倍 | 不合并护理类；两者在图 1 里各标各的 |
| 总暴露度几乎等于语言维度 | 对语言 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_lang_tot)`、对图像 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_img_tot)`；语言与图像之间 `r sprintf("%.3f", r_lang_img)` | 不用 `ai_exposure` 单列下结论，第三节起拆两支分别画 |
| 通用职业代码稀释专业信息 | `r n_shared_soc` 个职业被 ≥10 个专业共用（最多 `r top_share_soc$occupation`，`r top_share_soc$n` 个专业）；每专业职业数 1 ~ `r max(occ_per_major)`，中位 `r median(occ_per_major)` | 图 4 用少数几个专业拆开给人看，不做职业层面的排名 |

## 方法与口径

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 数据 | `data/ai_salary_majors.csv`（`r n_majors` × 13，一行一专业，`cip4` 唯一）；`data/major_occupations.csv`（`r format(n_occ_pairs, big.mark = ",")` × 7） |
| 覆盖 | `r n_majors` 个学士专业 / `r n_soc` 个 SOC 职业 / `r n_distinct(raw$broad_field_short)` 个 CIP 大类；`n_graduates` 合计 `r format(sum(raw$n_graduates), big.mark = ",")` |
| 入图样本 | 图 1 / 3 用全部 `r n_majors`；图 2 每个维度 `r tt_flow(n_majors, 190, "弃掉该维度中间三分之一")`；图 4 只画 6 个专业 |
| 起薪口径 | `median_starting_salary` = 毕业一年后收入中位数，院校级值的**未加权中位数**；不是应届、不是生涯起薪，也不按毕业生人数加权 |
| 暴露口径 | `ai_exposure` = 该专业全部去向职业 AIOE 的**算术平均**（`n_occupations` 见各表）；AIOE 已标准化（均值 0、SD 1），0 = 平均职业 |
| 相关性口径 | 全部为 Pearson；Spearman 与 log 起薪两档作为替换检验写在图 1；置信区间用 Fisher z 变换，未对分组或机构规模做任何调整 |
| 分组口径 | 37 个 `broad_field_short` 折成 4 组是我为读图做的合并，**不是 NCES 分类**；规则摊在第四节的「分组合并规则明细」表里 |
| 不作为证据的列 | `ai_exposure_percentile`（与 `ai_exposure` 同源，只换刻度）；`median_salary_4yr`（缺失集中在单机构专业，且与 1 年列不同口径）；`n_institutions` / `n_graduates` 只用来给结论定权重，不做自变量 |
| 明确不画的东西 | 不画 37 个 `broad_field_short` 的逐类排名（多数类不足 5 个专业，排的是抽样噪声）；不画国家或院校层面（数据里没有）；不画时间趋势（Scorecard 快照只有一个版本）；不把暴露度画成「安全 / 危险」二分（AIOE 不含替代概率，二分等于替数据下结论） |
| 数字来源 | 正文每个内联数字都来自本页分析代码的同一份聚合，经 `sprintf` / `format` 定型 |

```{r}
#| label: typography-audit
#| include: false
audit <- bind_rows(
  tt_audit(fig1) |> mutate(图 = "图 1", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig2) |> mutate(图 = "图 2", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig3) |> mutate(图 = "图 3", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig4) |> mutate(图 = "图 4", .before = 1)
)
n_size_used <- n_distinct(audit$size[!is.na(audit$size)])
n_family    <- n_distinct(audit$family[!is.na(audit$family)])
n_off       <- sum(!audit$in_ladder)
stopifnot(n_size_used <= TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family <= TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off == 0)
stopifnot(length(PAL) <= 5, all(nchar(unlist(PAL)) == 7L))
cat(sprintf("typo-audit: sizes %d/%d, families %d/%d, off-ladder %d, colours %d\n",
            n_size_used, TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family, TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off, length(PAL)),
    file = stderr())
cat(sprintf("num-check: r_all=%.4f r_lang=%.3f r_img=%.3f r_within=%.3f quad=%s\n",
            r_all, r_lang, r_img, r_within_all,
            paste(qt$n, collapse = "/")), file = stderr())
```
